stories.title: OpenAI, Anthropic face new oversight as New York’s AI safety law takes effect
stories.take: New York moves first on enforcement: major AI labs must register, disclose safety practices and report critical incidents or face fines.

stories.title: All 7 Anthropic founders will each cash out about $250M in IPO
stories.take: All seven co-founders sell identical stakes at the IPO midpoint — about $250M each — while keeping control of the company.

stories.title: Oura to acquire AI-native primary care startup Counsel Health for $625M
stories.take: Oura buys its way into primary care for $625M, weeks after shelving its own IPO over market uncertainty.

stories.title: Anthropic launches Claude Meetings to turn workplace discussions into plans and tasks
stories.take: Claude now sits in the meeting, drafts the plan as you talk, maps the timeline and pulls in your work apps.

stories.title: OpenAI rolls out new business profiles, making ChatGPT just a little bit more like Google
stories.take: ChatGPT becomes a discovery engine: business profiles let brands shape how they show up in answers.

stories.title: Pixel Tag, Google’s $30 Android-ready answer to Apple’s AirTag, is now available
stories.take: Google's $30 tracker is finally here — Android's answer to AirTag, years late but cheap.

stories.title: X-energy gets green light to build its first small modular nuclear reactors
stories.take: Regulators clear X-energy to build four small modular reactors in Texas — a real test for next-gen nuclear.

stories.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang’s affair with alleged Chinese spy: a timeline
stories.take: The timeline fills in: how the Huang affair grew from rumor to a national-security and investor problem for Nvidia.

stories.title: OpenAI’s new business agents give brands a free way into the conversation it’s also selling as an ad
stories.take: Brands get a free route into ChatGPT via business agents — but OpenAI keeps the data and the recommendations.

stories.title: Adobe unveils Photoshop 2027 with a host of new AI features
stories.take: Photoshop 2027 leans hard into AI to cut the busywork — the question is how much control editors keep.

stories.title: Adobe Premiere Pro is getting an AI agent to do the boring editing jobs
stories.take: Premiere's new Creative Agent takes the tedious cuts, gap-fill and grading passes at Adobe Max.

stories.title: Adobe's approach to AI has pleasantly surprised me
stories.take: A skeptical read from Adobe Max: the keynote landed as cautiously hopeful instead of AI-for-its-own-sake.

stories.title: Commerce Media’s Consolidation Era Is Here
stories.take: Adweek calls 2027 a consolidation year, with DoorDash, Delta and McDonald's making the big commerce-media moves.

stories.title: Priceline’s AI agent Penny lands in Snapchat ads amid holiday rush
stories.take: Priceline is first in travel to put its own AI chatbot inside Snapchat's Sponsored Snaps for the holiday rush.

stories.title: Synthetic audiences fall short: What marketers need to know
stories.take: AI-simulated audiences can blind brands to real new customers — synthetic reach is not real reach.

stories.title: Is ArtStation's new AI art policy good enough?
stories.take: ArtStation tries to split the difference on AI art; artists get a policy that pleases almost no one completely.

stories.title: Cooper Flagg beats LeBron James, Anthony Edwards to NBA history: How the Mavericks star leveled up
stories.take: Flagg is the first teenager in NBA history with five 40-point games — ahead of LeBron and Ant on that list.

stories.title: Wembanyama scores 40 points in 25 minutes as Spurs win 9th straight
stories.take: 40 points, 11 rebounds and 9 blocks in 25 minutes: Wemby and the Spurs have won nine straight.

stories.title: Warriors, told 'PASS TO STEPH' by Butler dressed as coach, win 8th straight by 51
stories.take: Golden State wins its eighth straight by 51 over New Orleans, with Curry scoring 25 in barely 20 minutes.

stories.title: Raptors say Leonard will miss at least 1 more week due to knee swelling
stories.take: Kawhi sits at least another week with knee swelling — Toronto's timeline stays vague.

stories.title: LeBron-Durant-backed Futures League, featuring top U18 players, to launch in April
stories.take: A LeBron- and Durant-backed league for the top 120 under-18 players launches in April 2027, aimed straight at the prep-to-pro pipeline.

stories.title: Jaylen Brown is rewriting an old narrative﻿ with a new chapter in Philadelphia
stories.take: Brown faces Tatum and the Celtics tonight in Philly — the first grudge game of his post-Boston chapter.

stories.title: MLB rumors: Mets to meet with Tarik Skubal, Braves' Ronald Acuña Jr. plan, plus Blue Jays, Cubs, Red Sox, more
stories.take: GM meetings open with the Mets in line for Skubal and Atlanta mapping its Acuña plan — the hot stove is lit.

stories.title: Sources: Cubs starter Brown undergoes spine surgery, targets early '27 return
stories.take: Cubs starter Ben Brown had cervical spine surgery Monday and is targeting an early-2027 return.

stories.title: Tigers SS Kevin McGonigle, Reds 1B Sal Stewart win MLB's rookie of year awards
stories.take: Two 22-year-olds take Rookie of the Year: McGonigle in the AL, Stewart in the NL.

stories.title: World Series champ Bob Boone, part of MLB's first 3-generation family, dies at 78
stories.take: Bob Boone — seven Gold Gloves, a World Series ring, and the middle of MLB's first three-generation family — dies at 78.

stories.title: Pedro Martinez appeals to MLB, players: 'Get something done' to avoid lockout
stories.take: Pedro's plea to both sides: settle the CBA and don't lock out the fans.

stories.title: Jim Jordan, Trump ally and Maga firebrand, to lead House Republicans as minority leader next year - live
stories.take: House Republicans pick Jim Jordan as minority leader, 106–73 over Steve Scalise, after their midterm defeats.

stories.title: US inflation rose 0.4% in October as price increases cooled and gas costs dipped
stories.take: Inflation rose 0.4% in October — hotter than hoped, even as gas dipped below $4 for the first time in three months.

stories.title: US officials seek ‘final end’ to Russia-Ukraine war, as Abu Dhabi talks set to continue
stories.take: U.S. officials push for a 'final end' to the war as the first substantive Russia-Ukraine talks since February continue in Abu Dhabi.

stories.title: Hegseth lays it on thick for Trump to shave off fallout from Iran war
stories.take: Hegseth calls the impeachment push a 'farce' in a press conference aimed squarely at an audience of one.

stories.title: U.S. soldier arrested in Britain accused of espionage linked to Russia
stories.take: A senior U.S. soldier is arrested in Britain on espionage allegations tied to Russia, in a joint UK-U.S. investigation.

stories.title: FDA warns of rare eye condition causing blindness from GLP-1 weight loss medications
stories.take: FDA orders new warning labels on all GLP-1 drugs for a rare eye condition that can cause blindness.

stories.title: U.S. boycotts U.N. human rights review for second year running
stories.take: The U.S. skips its U.N. human rights review for a second straight year; rights groups warn the absence weakens global accountability.

stories.title: Fire at massive L.A. County business triggers air quality alert
stories.take: A massive Vernon warehouse fire burns for a second day, triggering road closures and an air-quality alert across L.A. County.

stories.title: San Diego school officials push back after Haitian boy, 8, is taken during ICE check-in
stories.take: San Diego school officials push back after an 8-year-old third-grader was taken during an ICE check-in; his father was deported to Mexico.

stories.title: CA pension funds were hedging Nvidia even before the affair
stories.take: CalPERS and CalSTRS were already hedging Nvidia before the Huang scandal — the pension funds braced for an AI downturn early.

stories.title: Chabria: Inside the prison cell where Newsom made his death row decision
stories.take: Inside the San Quentin cell where Newsom decided to commute every California death sentence — 548 of them.

stories.title: Voters approve Prop. 38 medical research bond measure
stories.take: Voters pass Prop. 38: $8.4 billion in bonds for immunology and immunotherapy research.

stories.title: Veres, Harris and Winston win terms on L.A. Community College board
stories.take: Veres, Harris and Winston win seats on the L.A. Community College board, the nation's largest community-college district.

stories.title: It only takes a prick to pop a bubble
stories.take: The answer: Nvidia itself is the prick that could pop the bubble — Huang is so central to Nvidia, and Nvidia to the AI build-out, that a compromised Nvidia can't prop up dependent neo-clouds like CoreWeave • Megaspede, Alice Wong's neo-cloud, bought nearly $5B in Nvidia chips and rents capacity to Alibaba around U.S. export controls • Nvidia admitted the affair but says no secrets were compromised; the hosts say it can't know that in 36 hours and its credibility is shot • Also: Ring's $250 Drone Cam ships Jan. 27 and the $1,000 Rover Cam Dec. 19

stories.title: Anthropic Targets $1.4 Trillion Valuation in Blockbuster IPO
stories.take: Anthropic targets a $1.4T fully diluted valuation at the top end — a $64B IPO plus a $26B private placement from AMD, Broadcom, Google, Micron, Microsoft, Nvidia and TSMC; pricing next Wednesday, retail expected to get 15–20% • Nvidia fell 3.8% to a seven-month low as Trump said the FBI is looking into Huang's relationship with a Megaspeed executive • Skydance fell 9% on its first combined earnings, carrying $80B in debt • GTA 6 launches Nov. 19; Bloomberg Intelligence estimates 40–60M units in year one

stories.title: AI also lost the election
stories.take: The answer: AI lost through the data-center backlash — data-center measures appeared on ballots over 40 times across 10 states and 40 of 41 were voted down, and Democrats who opposed data-center backers won • Alex Bores's agenda: mandatory third-party auditors with employee-level access, safety-incident disclosure, federal chip-verification investment, and a lame-duck ban on fully recursive self-improvement • OpenAI's Chris Lehane rebrands data centers as 'compute campuses' with six-figure jobs and offers 'speed limits' instead of a binary ban • Both guests call 2026 'the trailer to 2028' — AI may be the issue in 2028
